hold.reviewerReason: HOLD: shiji 050 s0009 王次兄仲於代 names Gaozu's younger brother 仲 as early Western Han Dai king material. Accepted membership's Later Han anchor 東萊劉喜 (Hou Hanshu 038 s0144) is a different century, different biography and office. That protected false merge contradicts primary chapter attribution even though Hanshu-era 仲 witnesses are sealed outside this transport slice.

primarySourceWitnesses.enLiteral: He then established his second brother Zhong as king in Dai.
primarySourceWitnesses.enIdiomatic: His second brother, Zhong, was made King of Dai.
primarySourceWitnesses.role: Gaozu’s second brother enfeoffed as King of Dai at founding (Western Han).

primarySourceWitnesses.zh: 壬子，以雲中、鴈門、代郡五十三縣立兄宜信侯喜為代王，以膠東、膠西、臨淄、濟北、博陽、城陽郡七十三縣立子肥為齊王，以太原郡三十一縣為韓國，徙 韓王信都晉陽。
primarySourceWitnesses.enIdiomatic: On the renzi day, he established his elder brother Xi, Marquis of Yixin, as King of Dai with Yunzhong, Yanmen, and Dai commanderies, fifty-three counties in all; ...
primarySourceWitnesses.role: Western Han Liu Xi 喜 (also attested 仲) as King of Dai; same dynasty and office line as shiji/050:p008.

primarySourceWitnesses.enIdiomatic: Marquis Zhong of Heyang passed away.
primarySourceWitnesses.role: Western Han Heyang marquis 仲; continuation of the same early Han prince line.

primarySourceWitnesses.zh: 及北鄉侯立，遷太傅，與太尉東萊劉喜參錄尚書事。
primarySourceWitnesses.enIdiomatic: When the Marquis of Beixiang acceded, Feng Shi became grand tutor and, with Grand Commandant Liu Xi of Donglai, shared supervision of the Masters of Writing.
primarySourceWitnesses.role: Eastern Han Donglai Liu Xi 劉喜, grand commandant AD 125; distinct century, polity phase, and biography from the Dai king.

notes: Shared identity markers 劉喜; dossier dates and polity context align.

Homographic Liu Xi 劉喜 readings collide on Romanization/en:liu xi, but primary Chinese witnesses separate Western Han Dai king 喜/仲 (BC 201–193 era) from Eastern Han Donglai grand commandant 東萊劉喜 (AD 125). Shiji 050 s0009 and Hou Hanshu 038 s0144 contradict a single actor.
